evidence_sets.join: ZTF page describes a public telescope survey and its own releases; TESS page describes spacecraft images, target pixels, and downstream products. The case brief separately identifies the teaching archive as nightly images and says no data were supplied. Neither source establishes this target's actual coverage or whether a proposed third-party product shares inputs.
AAVSO atmospheric section states same-degree attenuation for target and comparisons as the cancellation condition; cloud spatial uniformity alone is not equated with same-degree measured effect.
IRAF task parameter table and output section define the task-level defaults and the blank-output replacement condition; no case reducer is identified.
AIJ guide's Astrometry Settings name the raw re-save toggle and its consequence; separate Data Processor section does not make that warning universal.

Astropy example joins a Time object carrying observer location, a source SkyCoord passed to light_travel_time, and TDB addition; documentation does not address arbitrary time labels imported from elsewhere.
